title: temporal-leakage-audit: a temporal leakage-response instrument for clinical trial outcome prediction
description: Code and reference outputs for Foresight or hindsight? Measuring temporal leakage in the evaluation of medical AI by availability-time censoring. Implements the temporal leakage-response curve and leakage-attributable performance (LAP) with cluster-bootstrap and variance-inflated confidence intervals, its calibration on synthetic data with known leakage and a numerical check of its formal properties; patient-level demonstrations on ICU mortality (PhysioNet 2012) and sepsis onset across two hospital systems (PhysioNet 2019) with decision-curve analysis; audits of the CTO, TrialBench and TOP benchmarks and an as-of-time-censored drug-program benchmark built from Open Targets, ClinicalTrials.gov and PubMed; a comparison with common leakage checks (split comparison, univariate screen, permutation importance); and a nested-prompt study of what language-model trial predictors draw on, with every prompt and response.
